_meta.source: 2026-09-07 依客戶提供簡報「MitoBitTech management team website.pptx」第 2 頁「What Differentiating NovaRadar to Accelerate Success」置換原本 4 項假設性文案，改為 6 項；英文為簡報原文（權威來源），繁中為翻譯

items.description_zhTW: 瑞大生技由新藥開發人員、生醫專業人士與連續創業家共同創立。
items.description_en: NovaRadar is built by drug developers, biomedical professionals, and serial entrepreneurs.

items.description_zhTW: 超過六成的生技延遲源自 CMC（化學、製造與管制），卻鮮少有人重視。瑞大生技協助企業降低 CMC 與法規風險，避免價值折損。
items.description_en: Over 60% of biotech delays originate from CMC — yet almost nobody emphasizes it. NovaRadar helps companies avoid value destruction by mitigating CMC and regulatory risk.

items.title_en: Speed to Clinical Proof of Concept
items.description_zhTW: 不只優化 IRR，瑞大生技更著重縮短達到關鍵價值反曲點的時間。
items.description_en: Not only optimizing IRR — NovaRadar optimizes time to the key value inflection point.

items.description_zhTW: 許多創投宣稱全球佈局，真正具備全球營運能力的卻不多。瑞大生技串連美國、台灣與歐洲的科學、CMC、臨床開發、量產、商業開發與資本。
items.description_en: Many VC funds invest globally. Few actually operate globally. NovaRadar connects the US, Taiwan, and Europe through science, CMC, clinical development, manufacturing, BD, and capital.

items.title_zhTW: 藥廠商業化思維與出場導向投資
items.description_zhTW: 多數早期創投著眼於技術本身，瑞大生技則從商業化產品角度思考：能否量產？能否取得 FDA 核准？能否吸引藥廠併購？
items.description_en: Most early-stage VCs think technology. NovaRadar thinks commercial product — can it scale, manufacture, gain FDA approval, and attract a pharma acquirer?

items.description_zhTW: 多數創投僅透過董事會參與治理，瑞大生技提供積極的營運指導與陪伴。
items.description_en: Most VCs participate only through board governance. NovaRadar provides active operating mentorship.
